note: Corrections applied on top of Muso.ai data at every sync. artistAliases fixes spelling and legal names, dropArtists removes non-artist tags, excludeTitlePatterns guarantees a release can never appear even if a source lists it.
excludeNote: Excluded ids are five other artists' songs that happen to share the title 'Release the Hounds' with The LaFontaines track. Muso matched them to the composer credit by title. Remove an id here to show it again.
